title: Đề Thi Trắc Nghiệm Tiếng Anh - Đọc Hiểu & Tổng Hợp

parts.partTitle: PART 1: Read a text about amazing adventurers
parts.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn về các nhà thám hiểm và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B hoặc C) để điền vào chỗ trống từ câu 1 đến câu 8.
parts.passage:
Do you ever dream about climbing Mount Everest or visiting Antarctica? If so, you're not alone. Every year, thousands of people try to climb the world's (1)............. mountains or walk across continents. Let's take a (2)...............at some of the 21st century's greatest adventurers.

Ed Stafford from the UK is the first person to walk along the Amazon River from the mountains of Peru to the mouth of the river in Brazil. His amazing journey (3).............. two years and four months. There are many dangerous animals in the rainforest, like snakes and crocodiles, but Ed was (4)............; he was only bitten by ants and mosquitoes. On his trip, Ed had to find fruit and nuts or (5)............ fish each morning. Sometimes food was (6)........... to find and Ed was often tired and hungry. While he walked, Ed wrote a blog to tell the world about climate change and destruction of the rainforest.

Gerlinde Kaltenbrunner from Austria is one among more than 4,000 people who have climbed Everest. She is one of the world's (7).............. climbers and has climbed all the world's mountains over 8,000 metres. It's very difficult to climb in cold weather and storms, but Gerlinde loves it. Now she (8)........ her time climbing and helping a charity for poor children in Nepal.

questions.question: Every year, thousands of people try to climb the world's (1)............. mountains...
questions.explainAnswer: "thousands of people try to climb the world's highest mountains" — dùng "highest" để nói về độ cao của núi.

questions.question: Let's take a (2)............... at some of the 21st century's greatest adventurers.
questions.explainAnswer: "Let's take a look at some of the 21st century's greatest adventures" — cụm "take a look at" là cách diễn đạt chuẩn.

questions.question: His amazing journey (3).............. two years and four months.
questions.explainAnswer: "His amazing journey took two years and four months" — "take + khoảng thời gian" nghĩa là mất bao lâu.

questions.question: There are many dangerous animals in the rainforest..., but Ed was (4)............; he was only bitten by ants and mosquitoes.
questions.explainAnswer: "but Ed was lucky; he was only bitten by ants and mosquitoes" — so với rắn, cá sấu nguy hiểm thì chỉ bị kiến, muỗi cắn là may mắn.

questions.question: On his trip, Ed had to find fruit and nuts or (5)............ fish each morning.
questions.explainAnswer: "Ed had to find fruit and nuts or catch fish each morning" — "catch fish" (bắt cá) là cụm đúng.

questions.question: Sometimes food was (6)........... to find and Ed was often tired and hungry.
questions.explainAnswer: "Sometimes food was hard to find and Ed was often tired and hungry" — thức ăn khó tìm nên anh đói và mệt.

questions.question: She is one of the world's (7).............. climbers...
questions.explainAnswer: "She is one of the world's greatest climbers" — "greatest" phù hợp để khen ngợi khả năng leo núi xuất sắc.

questions.question: Now she (8)........ her time climbing and helping a charity...
questions.explainAnswer: "Now she spends her time climbing and helping a charity" — "spend time doing something" là cụm chuẩn.

parts.partTitle: PART 2: Match the notice to the sentence
parts.instruction: Nối các thông báo (từ A đến K) tương ứng với từng mô tả từ câu 9 đến câu 16.

referenceNotices.A: SWIMMING POOL - ADULTS ONLY 6-8 p.m (Hồ bơi - Chỉ dành cho người lớn từ 18h-20h)
referenceNotices.B: TELEPHONE for customers' use only (Điện thoại chỉ dành cho khách hàng sử dụng)
referenceNotices.C: DANGER! No Traffic Lights Ahead (NGUY HIỂM! Phía trước không có đèn giao thông)
referenceNotices.D: PARKING FOR POLICE CARS ONLY (Bãi đỗ xe chỉ dành riêng cho xe cảnh sát)
referenceNotices.E: LEEDS CASTLE - FREE FOR CHILDREN (Lâu đài Leeds - Miễn phí cho trẻ em)
referenceNotices.F: Film matinee 2 p.m £3.00 (Suất chiếu phim ban ngày 14h - Giá 3 bảng)
referenceNotices.G: NEW Department store! Opening times: 10 a.m-10 p.m - Free parking for customers only! (Trung tâm thương mại mới! Giờ mở cửa: 10h-22h - Đỗ xe miễn phí chỉ dành cho khách hàng!)
referenceNotices.H: BUY NOW PAY NEXT YEAR (Mua ngay - Năm sau mới phải trả tiền)
referenceNotices.I: Keep this nightdress away from fire (Giữ bộ đồ ngủ này xa lửa/nguồn nhiệt)
referenceNotices.K: Under 12s HALF PRICE (Trẻ em dưới 12 tuổi giảm nửa giá)

questions.question: Not all drivers can stop here.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển D "PARKING FOR POLICE CARS ONLY" — chỉ xe cảnh sát được đỗ, các tài xế khác không được dừng ở đây.

questions.question: Children cannot come here in the evening.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển A "SWIMMING POOL — ADULTS ONLY 6-8 p.m." — buổi tối (6-8pm) chỉ dành cho người lớn, trẻ em không được vào.

questions.question: Drivers must be careful.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển C "DANGER! No Traffic Lights Ahead" — cảnh báo nguy hiểm phía trước không có đèn giao thông, tài xế phải cẩn thận.

questions.question: Not everyone can make a call from here.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển B "TELEPHONE for customers' use only" — điện thoại chỉ dành cho khách hàng sử dụng, không phải ai cũng gọi được.

questions.question: Only adults have to pay here.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển E "LEEDS CASTLE — FREE FOR CHILDREN" — trẻ em miễn phí, ngầm hiểu chỉ người lớn phải trả tiền.

questions.question: Children pay less than adult here.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển K "Under 12s — HALF PRICE" — trẻ dưới 12 tuổi được giảm nửa giá, tức trả ít hơn người lớn.

questions.question: Be careful because this will burn.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển I "Keep this nightdress away from fire" — cảnh báo áo ngủ dễ bắt lửa, cần tránh xa lửa.

questions.question: We don't want any money yet.
questions.explainAnswer: Biển H "BUY NOW PAY NEXT YEAR" — mua trước, trả tiền sau, tức chưa cần trả tiền ngay.

parts.instruction: Đọc 2 email trao đổi và điền thông tin vào đơn xin Visa (từ câu 17-23). Đáp án KHÔNG QUÁ 3 TỪ và/hoặc 1 SỐ.
parts.passage:
Email 1 (From Mariko Mori to Atlas Language School):
'I would like to study at your school. I work in the reception of a hotel in my home town, Nagoya, Japan, and English is important for my job. I have to communicate in English every day, so I would like to improve my English skills, especially listening and speaking. Where can I stay in Oxford? I shall spend 3 months in Britain.'

Email 2 (From Atlas Language School to Mariko Mori):
'We have 10-week courses for people who want to study English. There is a house for students next to the school, in Park Road, at number 324. You will need a visa.'

questions.question: Name of applicant:
questions.explainAnswer: Email được ký tên "Mariko Mori" — đây là người viết thư và cũng là người xin visa.

questions.question: Nationality:
questions.explainAnswer: Mariko viết cô làm việc "in the reception of a hotel in my home town, Nagoya, Japan" — quê cô ở Nhật Bản nên quốc tịch là Japanese.

questions.question: Job:
questions.explainAnswer: "I work in the reception of a hotel in my home town" — công việc của cô là lễ tân khách sạn.

questions.question: Address in Oxford:
questions.explainAnswer: Trường trả lời: "There is a house for students next to the school, in Park Road, at number 324" — địa chỉ nhà ở là 324 Park Road.

questions.question: School to apply for:
questions.explainAnswer: Email đầu tiên gửi "To: Atlas Language School, Oxford" — đây là trường Mariko muốn đăng ký học.

questions.question: The language you want to learn:
questions.explainAnswer: "I would like to improve my English skills, especially listening and speaking" — cô muốn học tiếng Anh.

questions.question: How long will you stay?
questions.explainAnswer: Mariko viết: "I shall spend 3 months in Britain" — thời gian ở lại là 3 tháng.

parts.partTitle: PART 4: Read a text about Dany Cotton a firefighter
parts.instruction: Đọc bài viết về nữ lính cứu hỏa Dany Cotton và chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho các câu hỏi từ 24 đến 30.
parts.passage:
People who think firefighting is a job for men would be surprised to learn that there are now over 230 women in the London Fire Brigade. One of them is Dany Cotton, who has been with the fire service for over 22 years.

Dany always tries to change the image of the Fire Brigade. She took part in a national campaign promoting firefighting as a career for girls in secondary schools. During the campaign, she explained that women do the same training and assessment as men and they are expected to do the same jobs. Both men and women must be fit and healthy, but height is not important.

However, Dany's favourite question is this: 'How can women carry a man down a ladder from a building which is on fire?' She says that in all her years of firefighting, she has never seen anyone try this, although she was trained to do it. She describes this as something we only see in films and explains that today's firefighters enter a building as a team to rescue people.

Dany says that saving people from burning buildings is not the only thing that firefighters do. One of the most important jobs they do these days is in the community. Fire officers visit homes, businesses and schools giving advice that can often save lives. Women are often good at doing this because of their ability to communicate well.

Most of Dany's work in the Fire Brigade these days is as manager in an office, but she still attends emergencies. One of the things she finds most interesting about her job is this combination of using her skills with people and working in real life emergency situations.

questions.question: Dany has worked for the fire service...

options.C: since she was twenty-two years old.

questions.explainAnswer: Bài viết nói: "Dany Cotton, who has been with the fire service for over 22 years" — hơn 22 năm nghĩa là hơn hai mươi năm.

questions.question: Dany worked on a campaign to...

options.A: encourage girls to train to become firefighters.
options.B: explain the training and assessment needs for firefighters.
options.C: advise girls at secondary school to keep fit and stay healthy.

questions.explainAnswer: "She took part in a national campaign promoting firefighting as a career for girls in secondary schools" — mục đích là khuyến khích các bạn nữ theo nghề cứu hỏa.

questions.question: Male firefighters...

options.A: have the same training as female firefighters.
options.B: often carry people down ladders in burning buildings.
options.C: have to be taller than female firefighters.

questions.explainAnswer: "women do the same training and assessment as men and they are expected to do the same jobs" — nam và nữ có cùng chương trình đào tạo.

questions.question: Dany has never...

options.A: seen a woman carry a man from a burning building.
options.B: been trained to carry a man from a burning building.
options.C: worked in a team to rescue people.

questions.explainAnswer: "she has never seen anyone try this, although she was trained to do it" — cô chưa từng chứng kiến cảnh này dù đã được huấn luyện.

questions.question: Firefighters can save people's lives by...
questions.explainAnswer: "Fire officers visit homes, businesses and schools giving advice that can often save lives" — chính lời khuyên của họ có thể cứu mạng người.

questions.question: Female firefighters seem to be good at...
questions.explainAnswer: "Women are often good at doing this because of their ability to communicate well" — nữ giới giỏi giao tiếp với công chúng.

questions.question: Dany is interested in...
questions.explainAnswer: "One of the things she finds most interesting about her job is this combination of using her skills with people and working in real life emergency situations" — cô thích sự đa dạng trong công việc.
